question.problem:
A rectangular plate occupies the region
$D=\{(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 1,\,\,0\le y\le 2\}$
with mass density function $\lambda (x,y)=2x+4y.$ Find the moment of inertia of this plate about the line $x=1.$
question.worked_solution:
The moment of inertia of a plane lamina in the shape of a region $D$ about an axis of rotation $l$ is given by

$$
{I}_{l}={∬}_{D}\lambda (x,y)[r(x,y)]^{2}\,\text{d}A,
$$

where $\lambda (x,y)$ is the mass density function of the lamina, and $r(x,y)$ is the distance from the line $l$ to the point $(x,y)$ on $D.$

The distance between a point on $D$ and the line $x=1$ is given by

$$
r(x,y)=|x-1|.
$$

Therefore, the moment of inertia about the line $x=1$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{I}_{l} & ={∬}_{D}\lambda (x,y)[r(x,y)]^{2}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}(2x+4y)|x-1{|}^{2}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}(2x+4y)(x-1)^{2}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}2x(x-1)^{2}+4y(x-1)^{2}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{[2xy(x-1)^{2}+2{y}^{2}(x-1)^{2}]}_{0}^{2}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}4x(x-1)^{2}+8(x-1)^{2}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(x-1)^{2}(4x+8)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}4{x}^{3}-12x+8\,\text{d}x \\  & ={[{x}^{4}-6{x}^{2}+8x]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =(1-6+8)-0 \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
